entry.title: Building domharvest-playwright: Why I Chose Simplicity Over Complexity
entry.summary:
I'm building domharvest-playwright, an open-source DOM extraction tool focused on simplicity and reliability. This is the first post documenting the journey. When starting a new project, we face countless decisions: TypeScript or JavaScript? Complex tooling or zero-config? Git Flow or GitHub Flow? I chose simplicity at every turn. Here's why. While TypeScript offers type safety, I opted for vanilla JavaScript to lower the barrier to entry. The goal is to make web scraping accessible without requiring TS knowledge. No .eslintrc, no Prettier config, no debates. StandardJS provides automatic formatting and linting with zero setup time. Simpler branching model: main + feature branches. No develop branch, no release branches. Perfect for solo/small team projects. The foundation is set. Next steps: Core scraping functionality with Playwright Resilient selector strategies
Comprehensive error handling Real-world testing Full post with detailed reasoning: https://domharvest.github.io/posts/building-domharvest-playwright/ Repository: https://github.com/domharvest/domharvest-playwright What's your take on simplicity vs. features in developer tools? Drop a comment!
